This supports the supplied facsimile reading of Y written over X.
rows.note: Replace the unresolved X|Y alternative at this one locus by deleted{X} inserted{Y}, preserving the visible older X as well as the surviving Y. The proposed change is based on the forked dominant stroke and long Y stem over the residual X legs, not on the expected target of the Picard restriction map. The dense junction limits the detail available for stroke order, but the upper fork and extended stem support final Y sufficiently for this proposal. No other occurrence of X or Y is changed.
